imdb:tt6343314.title: Creed II
imdb:tt6343314.description: Under the tutelage of Rocky Balboa, newly crowned heavyweight champion Adonis Creed faces off against Viktor Drago, the son of Ivan Drago.

imdb:tt6436726.description: When terrorists try to seize control of a Berlin-Paris flight, a soft-spoken American co-pilot struggles to save the lives of the passengers and crew while forging a surprising connection with one of the hijackers.

imdb:tt6450804.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
imdb:tt6450804.description: An augmented human and Sarah Connor must stop an advanced liquid Terminator from hunting down a young girl, whose fate is critical to the human race.

imdb:tt6495770.title: Action Point
imdb:tt6495770.description: A daredevil designs and operates his own theme park with his friends.

imdb:tt6499752.title: Upgrade
imdb:tt6499752.description: Set in the near-future, technology controls nearly all aspects of life. But when the world of Grey, a self-labeled technophobe, is turned upside down, his only hope for revenge is an experimental computer chip implant.

imdb:tt6521876.title: Jay and Silent Bob Reboot
imdb:tt6521876.description: Jay and Silent Bob inadvertently sign away their names and rights to the new Bluntman and Chronic movie. Now they head to Hollywood to stop the film from being made. Along the way Jay discovers that he is a father.

imdb:tt6565702.title: X-Men: Dark Phoenix
imdb:tt6565702.description: Jean Grey begins to develop incredible powers that corrupt and turn her into a Dark Phoenix, causing the X-Men to have to decide if her life is worth more than all of humanity.

imdb:tt6574272.title: Phoenix Forgotten
imdb:tt6574272.description: Two decades after three teenagers disappeared in the wake of mysterious lights appearing above Phoenix, Arizona, unseen footage from that night has been discovered, chronicling the final hours of their fateful expedition.

imdb:tt6628394.title: Bad Times at the El Royale
imdb:tt6628394.description: 1969. Four strangers check in at the El Royale Hotel. The hotel is deserted, staffed by a single desk clerk. Some of the new guests' reasons for being there are less than innocent and some are not who they appear to be.

imdb:tt6644200.title: A Quiet Place
imdb:tt6644200.description: A family struggles for survival in a world invaded by blind alien creatures with ultra-sensitive hearing.

imdb:tt6710474.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
imdb:tt6710474.description: A middle-aged Chinese immigrant is swept up into an insane adventure in which she alone can save existence by exploring other universes and connecting with the lives she could have led.

imdb:tt6718170.title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
imdb:tt6718170.description: Brooklyn plumbers Mario and Luigi are warped to the magical Mushroom Kingdom, and Mario must team up with Princess Peach, Toad, and Donkey Kong to save Luigi from the evil Bowser.

imdb:tt6723592.title: Tenet
imdb:tt6723592.description: Armed with only the word "Tenet," and fighting for the survival of the entire world, CIA operative, The Protagonist, journeys through a twilight world of international espionage on a global mission that unfolds beyond real time.

imdb:tt6791350.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
imdb:tt6791350.description: Still reeling from the loss of Gamora, Peter Quill rallies his team to defend the universe and one of their own - a mission that could mean the end of the Guardians if not successful.

imdb:tt6823368.title: Glass
imdb:tt6823368.description: Security guard David Dunn uses his supernatural abilities to track Kevin Wendell Crumb, a disturbed man who has twenty-four personalities.

imdb:tt6998518.title: Mandy
imdb:tt6998518.description: The enchanted lives of a couple in a secluded forest are brutally shattered by a nightmarish hippie cult and their demon-biker henchmen, propelling a man into a spiraling, surreal rampage of vengeance.

imdb:tt7068946.title: The Accountant 2
imdb:tt7068946.description: Christian Wolff applies his brilliant mind and illegal methods to reconstruct the unsolved puzzle of a Treasury chief's murder.

imdb:tt7069210.title: The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It
imdb:tt7069210.description: Arne Cheyenne Johnson stabs and murders his landlord, claiming to be under demonic possession while Ed and Lorraine Warren investigate the case and try to prove his innocence.

imdb:tt7097896.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
imdb:tt7097896.description: Eddie Brock attempts to reignite his career by interviewing serial killer Cletus Kasady, who becomes the host of the symbiote Carnage and escapes prison after a failed execution.

imdb:tt7126948.title: Wonder Woman 1984
imdb:tt7126948.description: Wonder Woman finds herself battling two opponents, Maxwell Lord, a shrewd entrepreneur, and Barbara Minerva, a friend-turned-foe. Meanwhile, she also ends up crossing paths with her love interest.

imdb:tt7131622.title: Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood
imdb:tt7131622.description: As Hollywood's Golden Age is winding down during the summer of 1969, television actor Rick Dalton and his stunt double Cliff Booth endeavor to achieve lasting success in Hollywood while meeting several colorful characters along th...

imdb:tt7144666.title: The Black Phone
imdb:tt7144666.description: After being abducted and locked in a basement, a boy starts receiving calls on a disconnected phone from the killer's previous victims.

imdb:tt7286456.title: Joker
imdb:tt7286456.description: Arthur Fleck, a party clown and a failed stand-up comedian, leads an impoverished life with his ailing mother. However, when society shuns him and brands him as a freak, he decides to embrace the life of chaos in Gotham City.

imdb:tt7394816.title: Primal
imdb:tt7394816.description: Frank's caught wildlife in the Brazilian jungle incl. a 400 lbs. white jaguar. He ships it on the same ship as an arrested assassin. The assassin breaks free and frees the animals.

imdb:tt7510346.title: The Turning
imdb:tt7510346.description: A young governess is hired to look after an orphaned girl, but the return of the girl's problematic brother uncovers secrets from their past. A modern take on Henry James' novella "The Turn of the Screw."

imdb:tt7737786.title: Greenland
imdb:tt7737786.description: To save his family from a catastrophic end of times, a man embarks on a risky quest to locate the last hope for salvation and witness the worst of mankind in the battle for survival.

imdb:tt7740510.title: Antlers
imdb:tt7740510.description: In an isolated Oregon town, a middle-school teacher and her sheriff brother become embroiled with her enigmatic student, whose dark secrets lead to terrifying encounters with an ancestral creature.

imdb:tt7752126.title: Brightburn
imdb:tt7752126.description: An alien that looks like a human boy uses its powers in sinister and destructive ways.

imdb:tt7888964.title: Nobody
imdb:tt7888964.description: A docile family man slowly reveals his true character after his house gets burgled by two petty thieves, which, coincidentally, leads him into a bloody war with a Russian crime boss.

imdb:tt7939766.title: I'm Thinking of Ending Things
imdb:tt7939766.description: Full of misgivings, a young woman travels with her new boyfriend to his parents' secluded farm. Upon arriving, she comes to question everything she thought she knew about him, and herself.

imdb:tt8015444.title: Last and First Men
imdb:tt8015444.description: Two billion years ahead of us, a future race of humans finds itself on the verge of extinction. Almost all that is left in the world are lone and surreal monuments, beaming their message into the wilderness.

imdb:tt8041270.title: Jurassic World: Dominion
imdb:tt8041270.description: Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, Biosyn operatives attempt to track down Maisie Lockwood, while Dr Ellie Sattler investigates a genetically engineered swarm of giant insects.

imdb:tt8080204.title: Hypnotic
imdb:tt8080204.description: A detective investigates a mystery involving his missing daughter and a secret government program.

imdb:tt8201852.title: You Should Have Left
imdb:tt8201852.description: A former banker, his actress wife, and their spirited daughter book a vacation at an isolated modern home in the Welsh countryside where nothing is quite as it seems.

imdb:tt8232756.title: Spiral
imdb:tt8232756.description: This story is about letting go. Sometimes we can't let go, and this might result in consequences that end in tragedy. There's only one thing we can do: face ourselves.

imdb:tt8296030.title: You Won't Be Alone
imdb:tt8296030.description: In an isolated mountain village in 19th century Macedonia, a young girl is kidnapped and then transformed into a witch by an ancient spirit.

imdb:tt8332802.title: Amulet
imdb:tt8332802.description: An ex-soldier, living homeless in London, is offered a place to stay at a decaying house inhabited by a young woman and her dying mother. As he starts to fall for her, he cannot ignore his suspicion that something sinister is goin...

imdb:tt8332922.title: A Quiet Place Part II
imdb:tt8332922.description: Following the events at home, the Abbott family now face the terrors of the outside world. Forced to venture into the unknown, they realize the creatures that hunt by sound are not the only threats lurking beyond the sand path.

imdb:tt8350360.title: Annabelle Comes Home
imdb:tt8350360.description: While babysitting the daughter of Ed and Lorraine Warren, a teenager and her friend unknowingly awaken an evil spirit trapped in a doll.

imdb:tt8368406.title: Vivarium
imdb:tt8368406.description: A young couple looking for the perfect home find themselves trapped in a mysterious labyrinth-like neighborhood of identical houses.

imdb:tt8399288.title: Memoria
imdb:tt8399288.description: A woman from Scotland, while traveling in Colombia, begins to notice strange sounds. Soon she begins to think about their appearance.

imdb:tt8633464.title: After Yang
imdb:tt8633464.description: In a near future, a family reckons with questions of love, connection, and loss after their A.I. helper unexpectedly breaks down.

imdb:tt8772262.title: Midsommar
imdb:tt8772262.description: A couple travels to Northern Europe to visit a rural hometown's fabled Swedish mid-summer festival. What begins as an idyllic retreat quickly devolves into an increasingly violent and bizarre competition at the hands of a pagan cult.

imdb:tt9086228.title: Gretel & Hansel
imdb:tt9086228.description: In a distant land, two siblings, Hansel and Gretel, wander through the woods in search of food and work. When a mysterious lady offers them a way out, they accept without thinking about the consequences.

imdb:tt9198364.title: Three Thousand Years of Longing
imdb:tt9198364.description: A lonely scholar, on a trip to Istanbul, discovers a Djinn who offers her three wishes in exchange for his freedom.

imdb:tt9214772.title: Monkey Man
imdb:tt9214772.description: An anonymous young man unleashes a campaign of vengeance against the corrupt leaders who murdered his mother and continue to systematically victimize the poor and powerless.

imdb:tt9218128.title: Gladiator II
imdb:tt9218128.description: After his home is conquered by the tyrannical emperors who now lead Rome, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum and must look to his past to find strength to return the glory of Rome to its people.

imdb:tt9373688.title: Settlers
imdb:tt9373688.description: Mankind's earliest settlers on the Martian frontier do what they must to survive the cosmic elements and each other.

imdb:tt9639470.title: Last Night in Soho
imdb:tt9639470.description: Aspiring fashion designer Eloise is mysteriously able to return to 1960s London, where she encounters dazzling wannabe singer Sandie. But the glamour is not as it seems, and the dreams of the past crack and splinter into something...

imdb:tt9663764.title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
imdb:tt9663764.description: Black Manta seeks revenge on Aquaman for his father's death. Wielding the Black Trident's power, he becomes a formidable foe. To defend Atlantis, Aquaman forges an alliance with his imprisoned brother. They must protect the kingdom.

imdb:tt9664108.title: Voyagers
imdb:tt9664108.description: A crew of astronauts on a multi-generational mission descend into paranoia and madness, not knowing what is real or not.

imdb:tt9812474.title: Lamb
imdb:tt9812474.description: A childless couple discovers a mysterious newborn on their farm in Iceland.
